caption: This shio broth ramen features a clear, golden-brown, glossy soup with thin noodles and shredded cabbage. Served in a light gray ceramic bowl on a vibrant red table, it includes a halved egg, nori seaweed, and chashu pork.

segments_info.text: The table is a solid, vibrant red surface with smooth texture and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with pinkish meat and white fat, irregularly shaped with slightly uneven surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-brown, and glossy, with thin noodles and shredded cabbage floating on its surface.
A halved boiled egg shows a firm white and a vibrant yellow yolk with a slightly textured surface.
Light gray ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, subtle speckled texture, and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A pale, translucent spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, elongated shape.
